GEO ROI claims are outrunning the evidence
This visual is a reality check for the AEO/GEO hype cycle. The survey it cites says the independent evidence is still thin outside vendor case studies, and the stronger claims are not yet matched by strong testing.
The useful bits are blunt:
– Only 2 studies had real traffic/conversion data outside controlled benchmarks
– 3/54 tactic-domain combinations showed a significant positive effect in C-SEO Bench
– SAGEO Arena found body text optimization reduced citation frequency by 6–9%
So yes, there are case studies. But reproducible evidence is still weak, and some of the louder ROI claims are doing too much.
That’s the tension the SEO/AEO research is really pointing at.
Data source:
arXiv
Related read:
Are we optimising for the right engine? Insights from the latest SEO / AEO research

South Korea moves entire capital markets infrastructure onchain via Avalanche –
Link
South Korea's Financial Services Commission and Korea Securities Depository are laying groundwork to bring stocks, bonds, and funds onchain using Avalanche. The scope includes issuance, trading, clearing, settlement, and investor rights.
Matters because: this is one of the most ambitious government-led tokenization efforts to date and could support Avalanche's long-term institutional adoption narrative.
